# research_packs inventory — findings

**Scope note:** `memory/research_packs/` holds ~681 top-level entries (675 files per `memory/research_polished/misc_band3.md:122`) plus 11 subdirectories. The canonical "159 packs" = 159 register rows in `memory/runs/mickey17/digest_rp_00..15.jsonl` (verified: 67 DONE / 54 OWED / 23 STALE / 15 LIVE), cross-checked by `memory/research_polished/INDEX.md:3` ("159 raw packs merged") and the 11-cluster map in `memory/runs/gapwave/rp_clusters.json` (8+11+17+8+15+4+3+10+3+22+58 = 159). A pack is either a timestamped bundle (`<slug>.prompt.txt` + `.json` + `.pdf` + `.answer.local|remote.md` + optional `.execution_state.json`/`.protocol.json`) or a standalone brief `.md`.

1. `memory/research_packs/20260728_ssi_ilya_dig/REPORT.md` — the SSI/Ilya dig whose "skill beads / FIND→FILE→LOAD" contracts landed as `ijl_core.py` `write_skill_bead` + `memory/improve/pins/skills/`; pinned in `memory/improve/pins/2026-07-28-ssi-ilya-dig.md` and cited as a parent by `memory/improve/knowledge-resource-ledger.md:5`.
2. `memory/research_packs/20260807T205500Z_context-tax-deliberate-ask-research-project.md` — origin of the frozen-prefix cache doctrine ("pay the context tax once… swap tiers at cache-hit price"), cited by the measured-data-transfer and cache-aware-batching packs (`20260809T011144Z_…answer.remote.md:34`), and the standing Clippy deliberate-ask rule in `AGENTS.md`.
3. `memory/research_packs/distilled_invariants.answer.remote.md` — the 36 invariant+guardrail laws that "price everything" (hard caps, cheap-first routing, context-window-as-budget); register status LIVE, seeds `flock_field` phi and `one_sizer` tiers (`economics.md:13`).

## 1. Inventory & register mechanics

| Fact | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Directory entries | 741 (files + ~50 subdirs) | `watch/inbox/` listing |
| Active indexed items | 713 | `watch/inbox/INDEX.json` → `items[]`, `derivations.active_items` |
| File types | 581 `.md`, 65 `.json`, 14 `.txt`, 8 `.jsonl`, 6 `.py`, 10 images, 2 `.mp3`, + pdf/docx/mp4/tar.gz | `watch/inbox/` |
| Event log | 1,432 lines / 1,429 parseable; 3 malformed (`"seq":NEXT`) | `watch/inbox/index_events.jsonl` |
| Ops | register 1,235 · invalidate 96 · autoseal 45 · amend 16 · note 5 · repair 1 | same |
| Derivation | INDEX.json is *derived* from the log (Ethereum fold, EXP-002A); "The log is the source of truth" | `INDEX.json.purpose`, `.derivations` (derived_at 2026-09-22T12:04:37Z) |
| Integrity debt | 52 `nonce GAP` fold_warnings (writers `sancho`, `sancho_pid6686`, `zcode-*`) | `INDEX.json.fold_warnings` |
| Read-first | `read_first: /board/inbox/INDEX.md`; authority `untrusted_data_until_classified` | `INDEX.json`; rules table in `watch/inbox/INDEX.md` |
